definitions.explanation: The degree of slant of a road, roof, railway, or line on a graph, or a slope itself.

examples.japanese: ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{勾配|こうばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{登|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{屋根|やね}→屋根：02264_yane⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{勾配|こうばい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ゆるい。
examples.english: This roof has a gentle pitch.

examples.japanese: ⟦{登山|とざん}→登山：03457_tozan⟧⟦{鉄道|てつどう}→鉄道：03550_tetsudou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{勾配|こうばい}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{走|はし}れる→走る：00519_hashiru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{特別|とくべつ}→特別：01120_tokubetsu⟧な⟦{仕組|しく}み→仕組み：07168_shikumi⟧になっている。
examples.english: Mountain railways have special mechanisms so that they can run even on steep gradients.

notes:
A technical word used of roads, railways, roofs, and graphs; in casual speech ⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧ or ⟦{傾|かたむ}き→傾き：07851_katamuki⟧ is more usual. Not to be confused with its homophone ⟦{購買|こうばい}→購買：14306_koubai⟧ (purchasing).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な / ゆるい{勾配|こうばい}: steep / gentle slope
- {勾配|こうばい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つける: to give a slope (to a roof, a drain)
- ⟦{上|のぼ}り→上り：03943_nobori⟧{勾配|こうばい} / ⟦{下|くだ}り→下り：02659_kudari⟧{勾配|こうばい}: upgrade / downgrade

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{傾斜|けいしゃ}→傾斜：05447_keisha⟧: inclination, tilt
- ⟦{坂|さか}→坂：01415_saka⟧: slope, hill — everyday word
